summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-K5 admits no external crate. academic-retention is built entirely from dependencies earlier receipts already admitted (hex, serde, serde_json, sha2, thiserror) plus the workspace path crates academic-crypto, academic-domain, and academic-vault. The rotation journal is JSON Lines because t068 section 3.2 names keys/rotation-journal.jsonl, and serde_json is Phase 0 admitted; no new serialization crate enters.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-retention is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It exists because the four things P2-K5 owns — the append-only rotation journal, recipient add and revoke, the crypto-shred that destroys an object key slot, and the deletion plan with its {PLANNED, COMPLETE, PARTIAL, REPAIR_REQUIRED} vocabulary — are one contract. academic-crypto writes no file and selects no policy, so the journal cannot live there; academic-vault owns an object format, not a retention planner; and academic-portability is reachable only from the encrypted lane, which needs a native SQLCipher toolchain and therefore does not run in hosted CI. This is the same reasoning P2-K4 recorded for academic-recovery. The journal, plan, vocabulary, and revocation contract are pure Rust in the default lane and run on every CI platform; only the executor that rewraps and shreds real AEAD_CHUNKED_V2 objects needs the non-default rotation-engine feature, which selects academic-vault/aead-objects.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It reads no clock: every timestamp is supplied by the caller. Its only host interaction is reading and writing files under a caller-supplied profile root and, under the test-only phase2-fault-injection feature, reading the three failpoint environment variables a default build does not compile.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every crate academic-retention links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
